title: Promoter mutation-independent TERT expression is related to the immune-enriched milieu in papillary thyroid cancer.
authors: Seo, Dong Hyun; Lee, Seul Gi; Choi, Soon Min; Kim, Ha Yan; Park, Sunmi; Jung, Sang Geun; Jo, Young Suk; Lee, Jandee
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过生物信息学分析甲状腺癌中TERT表达机制，涉及转录因子c-MYC/NFkappaB，但核心是临床分型与生存预测，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Telomerase reverse transcriptase promoter mutation (pTERT MT) promotes human carcinogenesis via aberrant expression of telomerase reverse transcriptase (TERT). However, the tumorigenic impact of TERT expression independent of pTERT MT remains unclear despite numerous mechanisms of TERT being suggested. To tackle this issue, we employed comprehensive bioinformatics to assess biological variations noticed among different TERT expression mechanisms. Papillary thyroid cancer (PTC) with pTERT MT (pTERT MT PTC) presented aggressive clinical behavior and exhibited biological profiles associated with cellular immortality and genomic instability. PTC with TERT expression but without pTERT MT (TERT (+) PTC), also exhibited poor clinicopathological characteristics and was enriched with immune responses. In accordance, c-MYC/E2F and nuclear factor kappa B (NFkappaB) were dominant transcription factors in pTERT MT PTC and TERT (+) PTC, respectively. Notably, we revealed TERT hypermethylated oncological region (THOR) as a potential TERT expressing mechanism in TERT (+) PTC patients. Furthermore, three unique subtypes of papillary thyroid cancer were deciphered using a combination of machine learning-based scoring systems. Our proposed scoring system was clinically significant, especially in microcarcinoma, predicting survival outcomes and inferring therapeutic responses to radioactive iodine therapy. Finally, our analysis was expanded to endocrine-related cancers, unveiling various regulatory mechanisms of TERT with poor clinical outcomes and biological behaviors.
abstract_zh: 端粒酶逆转录酶启动子突变（pTERT MT）通过端粒酶逆转录酶（TERT）的异常表达促进人类致癌作用。然而，尽管已提出多种TERT机制，独立于pTERT MT的TERT表达对肿瘤发生的影响仍不明确。为解决此问题，我们采用综合生物信息学方法评估不同TERT表达机制间观察到的生物学差异。携带pTERT MT的甲状腺乳头状癌（pTERT MT PTC）表现出侵袭性临床行为，并呈现与细胞永生化和基因组不稳定性相关的生物学特征。表达TERT但无pTERT MT的甲状腺乳头状癌（TERT (+) PTC）也表现出不良的临床病理特征，并富集免疫反应。相应地，c-MYC/E2F和核因子κB（NFkappaB）分别作为pTERT MT PTC和TERT (+) PTC中的主要转录因子。值得注意的是，我们揭示TERT高甲基化肿瘤区域（THOR）可能是TERT (+) PTC患者中TERT表达的一种潜在机制。此外，通过基于机器学习的评分系统组合，我们解析出三种独特的甲状腺乳头状癌亚型。我们提出的评分系统具有临床意义，尤其在微小癌中，可预测生存结局并推断对放射性碘治疗的治疗反应。最后，我们将分析扩展到内分泌相关癌症，揭示了TERT的各种调控机制及其不良临床结局和生物学行为。
